item.title: DTN Traffic Simulation Relay Server
item.description: Overview DTN (Digital Twin Network) uses real traffic data to recreate road traffic in a digital environment and test operational alternatives virtually. I built the relay server between the user-facing client and the traffic simulation server. It submits analysis requests as simulation jobs, collects and transforms execution state and results, stores the output, and serves it to clients through APIs and WebSocket. Objective DTN evaluates signal-plan changes, incidents, roadworks, and other scenarios before they are applied to real roads.
